out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Continuous Towel System
violations.observation: Observed that the continuous towel system used at the handwashing sink is not providing clean towels. FACILITY HAS A HAND DRYER INSTALLED AT BACK HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the continuous towel system. Continuous towel systems shall supply the user with a clean towel to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PLEASE ENSURE PAPER TOWELS ARE PROVIDED AT THIS HANDWASHING SINK BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP. PIERO'S CORNER RISTORANTE (Inspection Date: 05/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the WITH A CONTAINER OF SOAPY WATER AND A DIRTY FOOD STORAGE CONTAINER AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC REMOVED ITEMS FROM SINK BASIN. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD ONLY BE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING IN THE 3-DOOR PREP-TOP ACROSS FROM COOK-LINE: RAW CHICKEN - 50F, SPINACH - 50-55F, COOKED VEGETABLES - 56F, UNSALTED BUTTER - 55F, CALAMARI - 54F, MASHED POTATOES - 55F OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING TEMPERATURES IN THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP (NEAR WALK-IN COOLER): CHEESE - 53F, DICED TOMATOES - 52F, COOKED BEETS - 50-56F, CALAMARI - 47F, SLICED TOMATOES - 56F. OBSERVED THE FOLLOWING TEMPERATURES IN THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP ON BACK WALL: BRUSCHETTA - 51F, DICED TOMATOES - 54F, ARUGULA - 60F, COOKED POTATOES - 51F, FRENCH FRIES - 54F, MOZZARELLA BALLS - 57F, CALAMARI - 53F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED ALL FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED INCONSISTENT DATE MARKING SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PLEASE ENSURE DATE MARKING SYSTEM IS IMPROVED AND MORE CONSISTENT BY THE TIME OF YOUR FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP UNDER-COUNTER COOLER, MAGIC CHEF COOLER, AND ALL THREE-DOOR PREP-TOPS.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE ADD UNIT THERMOMETERS TO ALL UNITS PRIOR TO FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE THREE-DOOR PREP-TOP ACROSS FROM COOK-LINE AT 54F, BACK WALL AT 56F, AND ACROSS FROM WALK-IN COOLER AT 60F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC CONTACTED A REPAIR TECHNICIAN DURING INSPECTION AND PLANS TO REPLACE ALL THREE COOLERS. ALL TCS FOODS WERE DISCARDED OR MOVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE PROVIDE THE SPECIFICATIONS TO THE EHS PRIOR TO PURCHASING NEW COOLERS AND ENSURE CORRECTION BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the BLEACH sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit BY TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED THE EQUIPMENT AT THE COOK-LINE, SHELVES THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN, AND INTERIOR OF MOST REFRIGERATORS IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE AREAS SHOULD BE CLEANED THOROUGHLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MEATBALLS AT 102- 131F IN STEAM TABLE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT MEATBALLS TO 165F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 44F IN 3 DOOR FLAT TOP; DICED HAM AT 46-48F IN ELINE 3 DOOR PREP TOP (PASTA STATION); GARLIC IN OIL AT 51F, RICE AT 44F IN TRUE 3 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD VARIOUS FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND TO DISCONTINUE STORING TCS FOODS IN THOSE UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED. PIC MAY ALSO USE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL FOR TCS FOODS TO BE STORED THERE. THE FOODS MUST HAVE START TEMPERATURE OF 41F OR BELOW, BE LABELED WITH 4 HOUR TIME PERIODS AND UNUSED PORTIONS MUST BE DISCARDED AFTER 4 HOURS. PLEASE ALSO REFRAIN FROM STORING FOODS ON TOP OF CONTAINERS IN THE PREP TOPS AND OVERFILLING CONTAINERS IN PREP TOP. INFORM EHS ONCE UNITS HAVE BEEN SERVICED.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED SMALL SINGLE USE CONTAINERS USED AS SCOOPS IN 3 DOOR PREP TOP (PASTA STATION) AND DRY STORAGE BINS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED CONTAINERS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: UNFINISHED WOOD ON SHELVING UNIT AT ENTRANCE TO KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SEAL OR REMOVE UNFINISHED WOOD.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: CONTINENAL 3 DOOR FLAT TOP AT 42F, ELINE 3 DOOR PREP TOP AT 47F WITH EHS THERMOMETER (PASTA STATION) , TRUE 3 DOOR PREP TO AT 47F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE STORING FOODS WHICH REQUIRE TIME OR TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY IN THOSE UNITS UNTIL REPAIRED. PLEASE ENSURE UNITS ARE ADJUSTED TO OPERATE BETWEEN 34-38F WHEN SERVICED. EMAIL EHS ONCE UNITS HAVE BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: SHELVING UNITS AT ENTRANCE TO KITCHEN AND DOUGH MIXER
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS IN DRY STORAGE, FLOORS NEAR AND UNDER EQUIPMENT AND FLOORS NEAR COOKLINE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
